service.en: Residence visa for individuals with specialised talents
service.ur: مخصوص صلاحیتوں کے حامل افراد کے لیے رہائشی ویزا

about: Get a visa to complete the 10-year Golden Residence process as a person with a specialised talent.
note: Requirements read from the official ICP service page on the checked date. ICP fills the form in from the person's records after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Needs a recommendation or approval from the relevant authority: culture, economy, sports, digital technology or other government bodies depending on the talent
Passport valid for at least 6 months
documents: Recommendation or approval for the talent category
channels: ICP Smart App or ICP Smart Services website (sign in with UAE PASS)
